entities.name: Sorin Markov
entities.description: A vampire planeswalker and master of sangromancy, one of the oldest living planeswalkers, who created Avacyn to protect Innistrad.

entities.name: Edgar Markov
entities.description: Sorin's grandfather, an alchemist noble who became the first vampire through Shilgengar's Ritual.

entities.name: Shilgengar
entities.description: A demon who gave Edgar the secrets of sangromancy.

entities.name: Archangel Marycz
entities.description: An archangel whose blood Sorin was forced to drink in the ritual.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A Kor lithomancer planeswalker from Zendikar, once Sorin's friend, whom he imprisoned in the Helvault and who later took vengeance on him.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ageless spirit dragon planeswalker who helped imprison the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: Aether-born monstrosities imprisoned on Zendikar by Sorin, Nahiri and Ugin.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane where the Eldrazi were imprisoned.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Sorin's home plane, which he strives to protect.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: The angel Sorin created to protect Innistrad, corrupted by Nahiri and destroyed by Sorin.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: A prison crafted by Sorin that was half of Innistrad's protection and held Nahiri.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A powerful vampire who made a deal with Sorin, took his sword, and later wed Edgar.

entities.name: Dack Fayden
entities.description: An interplanar thief who bargained with Sorin for the Ancient Fang.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elven planeswalker who traveled with Sorin to the Eye of Ugin and shattered the main hedron.

entities.name: Anowon
entities.description: A vampire ruin sage freed from slavery by Sorin.

entities.name: Brinelin
entities.description: A moon kraken who ruled the waters off Akoum.

entities.name: Smara
entities.description: A Kor woman, a witch vessel for a spirit in a crystal, traveling with goblins.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: An anarchistic young planeswalker Sorin dealt with on Innistrad.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An Elder Dragon who killed Ugin and later trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker saved by Sorin from Avacyn.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: A Soratami planeswalker saved from Avacyn.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that arrived on Innistrad after Avacyn's destruction.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer who led a zombie army to save the populace.

entities.name: Sigarda
entities.description: An angel who fought Sorin to buy time for Arlinn's team.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: A planeswalker who sought Sorin's aid and worked with him against New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Moonsilver Key
entities.description: A key Sorin held, later retrieved by Arlinn and the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The planeswalker coalition that approached Sorin for help.

entities.name: Katilda
entities.description: A spirit who emerged from the Moonsilver Key and freed Sigarda.

entities.name: Parasite Blade
entities.description: Sorin's two-handed, mana-feeding sword, taken by Olivia Voldaren.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A vampire baron bound by Sorin and later stranded on Ulgrotha.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The dragon plane Sorin visited to find Ugin.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica.

events.summary: At 16, Sorin is forced to drink the blood of the archangel Marycz in Shilgengar's Ritual, igniting his spark.
events.quote: The trauma of the transformation and the situation caused Sorin's planeswalker spark to ignite.

events.summary: Sorin allies with Nahiri and Ugin to imprison the Eldrazi on Zendikar.
events.quote: the three planeswalkers imprisoned them

events.summary: Sorin forges Avacyn to protect humanity from vampires, earning the title of traitor to his race.
events.quote: He named this creation Avacyn and tasked the angel with protecting the plane in his absence.

events.summary: Nahiri threatens Sorin after he admits her call for help was absorbed by the Helvault; he banishes her into it.
events.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

events.summary: Sorin trades Dack Fayden his life for the Ancient Fang and points him to Grixis.
events.quote: In exchange for the Ancient Fang , Sorin let Dack and his friends live.

events.summary: Sorin returns to Zendikar, allying with Nissa and freeing Anowon to reach the Eye of Ugin.
events.quote: he liberated the vampiric slave Anowon and demanded that the two take him to the Eye of Ugin

events.summary: Sorin reveals his mission and nature to Nissa on the voyage to Akoum.
events.quote: Sorin finally told Nissa the nature of their mission, as well as admitting to being a walker much like her.

events.summary: Nissa persuades Brinelin to lead them through the crystal reefs by telling him of Sutina's death.
events.quote: Brinelin finally acquiesced to lead them safely through the crystal reefs.

events.summary: Nissa shatters the main hedron at the Eye of Ugin, releasing the Eldrazi, and Sorin washes his hands of her and Zendikar.
events.quote: she shattered the main Hedron and released the enchantment imprisoning the titans

events.summary: Sorin returns to find Avacyn gone and Innistrad in chaos; he deals with Tibalt.
events.quote: Tibalt posed a significant threat if left unchecked

events.summary: Sorin visits Tarkir and, in the current timeline, awakens Ugin with Sorin's Restoration; Ugin tells him to find Nahiri.
events.quote: Sorin's Restoration awakened Ugin from his slumber

events.summary: Sorin finds Markov Manor ruined by Nahiri and seeks vampire allies, including Olivia Voldaren.
events.quote: Nahiri had left this declaration in stone as a warning of her vengeance.

events.summary: Sorin destroys the corrupted Avacyn in Thraben Cathedral to secure Olivia's help.
events.quote: Sorin was forced to unmake his corrupted guardian in the same spot where she was born.

events.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad as Sorin realizes he played into Nahiri's plan.
events.quote: Promptly, Emrakul arrived on Innistrad.

events.summary: Nahiri defeats Sorin and encases him in stone; Olivia takes his sword and declares herself lord of Innistrad.
events.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

events.summary: Sorin is lured to Ravnica and trapped by the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Sorin and Nahiri fight in single combat, then ally temporarily against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: they later came to a temporary truce, joining forces against the Eternals of Bolas' Dreadhorde

events.summary: Sorin, brooding in Markov Manor, refuses to give up the Moonsilver Key and attacks Arlinn's group until Sigarda intervenes.
events.quote: refused to relinquish the Moonsilver Key simply out of spite

events.summary: Sorin infiltrates Olivia and Edgar's wedding but is overwhelmed by guards and dragged away.
events.quote: he was forced to enter on his own

events.summary: Katilda frees Sigarda, whose fury shatters the wedding hall.
events.quote: Katilda used her powers to free the angel Sigarda from her prison.

events.summary: Sorin defeats Edgar and shows him mercy.
events.quote: Rather than killing Edgar, Sorin showed mercy and ordered him to leave.

events.summary: Sorin and Arlinn prepare Innistrad's defenses against New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Sorin and Arlinn Kord worked together to prepare Innistrad's defenses

relations.quote: his grandfather Edgar Markov was an aging alchemist noble

relations.note: He forged the angel to protect Innistrad and thought of her as a daughter.
relations.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires
he dissipated his progeny into an ashen cloud
not even a threat to the entire Multiverse could persuade them to put aside their feud
Sorin decided to ally with two other planeswalkers and trap these abominations.
He learned enough of Lithomancy from Nahiri

relations.note: He reminded her he raised her as a planeswalker.
relations.quote: angrily reminded her of who raised her as a planeswalker
After his grandfather agreed to marry Olivia Voldaren

relations.note: Traveled together to the Eye of Ugin until she betrayed his plan.
relations.quote: allied himself with Nissa Revane , an elven planeswalker
how Nahiri had turned his most precious creation against him

relations.note: She took his sword and later he attacked her at the wedding.
relations.quote: During the exchange of vows between Olivia and Edgar, Sorin attacked Olivia.
